name: Wand of Noisome Acid (2nd-Rank)
description:
This greasy stick emits a stomach-churning scent when held in a hand.

Activate Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day, plus overcharge

Effect You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9h9YCncqah6VNsKf]{Acid Grip} at 2nd rank. A creature that takes initial acid damage from this spell become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}. Use your spell DC if the creature attempts to recover from this sickness. This is an olfactory effect.

Craft Requirements Supply a casting of acid grip at 2nd rank

spell.name: Acid Grip
spell.description:
An ephemeral, taloned hand grips the target, burning it with magical acid. The target takes 2d8 acid damage plus @Damage[floor(@item.level/2)d6[persistent,acid]] damage depending on its Reflex save. A creature taking persistent damage from this spell takes a –10-foot status penalty to its Speeds. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.6TGcfVyzzVHEo7ke]{Spell Effect: Acid Grip}

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage and no persistent damage, and the claw moves it up to 5 feet in a direction of your choice.

Failure The creature takes full damage and persistent damage, and the claw moves it up to 10 feet in a direction of your choice.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and full persistent damage, and the claw moves it up to 20 feet in a direction of your choice.

Heightened (+2) The initial damage increases by 2d8, and the persistent acid damage increases by 1d6.

This greasy stick emits a stomach-churning scent when held in a hand.

Activate Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day, plus overcharge

Effect You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9h9YCncqah6VNsKf]{Acid Grip} at 8th rank. A creature that takes initial acid damage from this spell become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}. Use your spell DC if the creature attempts to recover from this sickness. This is an olfactory effect.

Craft Requirements Supply a casting of acid grip at 8th rank

name: Wand of Overflowing Life (3rd-Rank Spell)
description:
This alabaster wand has a clear crystal at the tip.

Activate Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day, plus overcharge

Effect You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} at 3rd-rank.

After you cast the spell, at the start of your next turn, excess healing magic wells up from the wand and heals you, as though you cast the 1-action version of heal on yourself at 3rd-rank. You gain this benefit only once per turn, even if you cast multiple heal spells from wands of overflowing life in the same turn.

Craft Requirements Supply a casting of heal at 3rd-rank.

spell.name: Heal
spell.description:
You channel vital energy to heal the living or damage the undead. If the target is a willing living creature, you restore 1d8 Hit Points. If the target is undead, you deal that amount of vitality damage to it, and it gets a basic Fortitude save. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.

1 The spell has a range of touch.

2 (concentrate) The spell has a range of 30 feet. If you're healing a living creature, increase the Hit Points restored by 8.

3 (concentrate) You disperse vital energy in a @Template[emanation|distance:30]. This targets all living and undead creatures in the burst.

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing or damage increases by 1d8, and the extra healing for the 2-action version increases by 8.

fr.name: Baguette de vie débordante (Rang 3)
fr.description:
Cette baguette en albâtre est dotée d'un cristal clair à son extrémité.

Activation Lancer un sort

Fréquence Une fois par jour, plus surcharger

Effet Vous lancez @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Guérison} au rang 3

Après avoir lancé ce sort, au début de votre prochain tour, un excès de magie de guérison jaillit de la baguette et vous soigne, comme si vous aviez lancé en 1 action la version du sort Guérison au rang 3 sur vous-même. Vous ne bénéficiez de cet avantage qu'une seule fois par tour, même si vous lancez plusieurs sorts Guérison à partir de baguettes de vie débordante dans le même tour.

Conditions de fabrication Fournir une incantation du sort Guérison au rang 3.

zh.name: 3环级满溢生命魔杖 Wand of Overflowing Life (3rd-Rank Spell)
zh.description:
这根雪花石膏制成的魔杖在顶部有一颗纯净的水晶。

启动 施放法术

频率 每日一次，外加过载

效果 你施放3环级@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]。

在你施展该法术后的下一个回合开始，满溢的治疗魔力从魔杖中涌出并治疗你自己，就如同你对自己施展了一个单动作版本的同环级治疗术。你只能获得该收益一次，即使你在同一回合内通过满溢生命魔杖施展了多次治疗术。

制造需求 提供一次对应环级的治疗术施法。

name: Wand of Paralytic Shock (3rd-Rank)
description:
A two-pronged metal rod, this wand has a handle coated in thick rubber. Each prong ends in a copper coil. When Activated, the wand produces a loud zapping sound.

Activate Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day, plus overcharge

Effect You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.DCQHaLrYXMI37dvW]{Paralyze}, electrocuting the target into immobility. Each target takes @Damage[1d12[electricity]] damage at the start of its turns while it remains stunned or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} due to the spell.

Craft Requirements Supply a casting of paralyze of the appropriate rank.

spell.name: Paralyze
spell.description:
You block the target's motor impulses before they can leave its mind, threatening to freeze the target in place. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target is Paralyzed for 4 rounds. At the end of each of its turns, it can attempt a new Will save to reduce the remaining duration by 1 round, or end it entirely on a critical success.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

fr.name: Baguette de choc paralysant (Rang 3)
fr.description:
Tige métallique à deux branches, cette baguette a une poignée recouverte d'un caoutchouc épais. Chaque tige se termine par une bobine de cuivre. Lorsqu'elle est activée, la baguette produit un fort son d'électricité statique.

name: Wand of Purification (2nd-Rank Spell)
description:
This cypress onusa rod is decorated with a number of paper streamers that rustle when shaken to direct purification magic. Wands of purification contain either @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.SUKaxVZW2TlM8lu0]{Cleanse Affliction}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.EfFMLVbmkBWmzoLF]{Clear Mind}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Et8RSCLx8w7uOLvo]{Sound Body}, decided when the wand is created.

Activate @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.aBQ8ajvEBByv45yz]{Cast a Spell}

Frequency once per day, plus overcharge

Effect You cast cleanse affliction, clear mind, or sound body of the indicated level. If your counteract check would be sufficient only to suppress the effect until the beginning of your next turn, instead of to fully counteract it, then you can Sustain the Activation of the wand each round to suppress the effect for an additional round, to a maximum of 1 minute. You Sustain the Activation by shaking the wand, so if at any point you release or otherwise drop the wand, the effect immediately stops being suppressed and resumes on the target as normal.

Craft Requirements Supply a casting of cleanse affliction, clear mind, or sound body, as appropriate.
publication: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

fr.name: Baguette de purification (rang 2)
fr.description:
Cet ōnusa est une tige en cyprès ornée d'un certain nombre de serpentins de papier qui bruissent lorsqu'on la secoue pour diriger la magie de purification. Les baguettes de purification contiennent soit @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.SUKaxVZW2TlM8lu0]{Affliction purifiée}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.EfFMLVbmkBWmzoLF]{Clarté d'esprit} ou @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Et8RSCLx8w7uOLvo]{Corps assaini}, choisi lors de la création de la baguette.

Activation @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.aBQ8ajvEBByv45yz]{Lancer un sort}

Fréquence Une fois par jour, plus surcharger

Effet Vous Lancez Affliction purifiée, Clarté d'esprit ou Corps assaini au rang 2. Si votre test de contre devrait être suffisant pour suspendre l'effet jusqu'au début de votre prochain tour, au lieu de le contrer complètement, alors vous pouvez Maintenir l'activation de la baguette à chaque round pour réprimer l'effet pendant un round supplémentaire, jusqu'à un maximum d'1 minute. Vous Maintenez l'activation en secouant la baguette, de sorte que si, à un moment donné, vous lâchez ou laissez tomber la baguette, l'effet cesse immédiatement d'être réprimé et reprend sur la cible comme à l'ordinaire.

Conditions de fabrication Fournir une incantation d'Affliction purifiée, de Clarté d'esprit ou Corps assaini au rang 2.

zh.description:
这根缟素柏木棒上装饰着许多纸幡，摇动时会发出沙沙声，引导净化魔法。净化魔杖容纳有@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.SUKaxVZW2TlM8lu0]，@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.EfFMLVbmkBWmzoLF]，或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Et8RSCLx8w7uOLvo]其中一种法术，由魔杖被制作时决定。

启动 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.aBQ8ajvEBByv45yz]

频率 每日一次，外加过载

效果 你施放对应环级的净化苦难，清神醒脑或身健体康。如果你的反制检定只能将效果抑制到你的下回合开始，而不是完全反制它，那么你可以每轮维持启动魔杖，来将效果再抑制1回合，至多到1分钟。你通过摇晃魔杖来维持启动，因此如果你在任何时候松开或丢下魔杖，效果则立即停止被抑制，恢复对目标的正常影响。

制作需求 视情况提供净化苦难，清神醒脑或身健体康的施法。

Conditions de fabrication Fournir une incantation d'Affliction purifiée, de Clarté d'esprit ou Corps assaini au rang 8.

zh.name: 8环级净化魔杖 Wand of Purification (8th-Rank Spell)
zh.description:
这根缟素柏木棒上装饰着许多纸幡，摇动时会发出沙沙声，引导净化魔法。净化魔杖容纳有@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.SUKaxVZW2TlM8lu0]，@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.EfFMLVbmkBWmzoLF]，或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Et8RSCLx8w7uOLvo]其中一种法术，由魔杖被制作时决定。

启动 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.aBQ8ajvEBByv45yz]

频率 每日一次，外加过载

效果 你施放对应环级的净化苦难，清神醒脑或身健体康。如果你的反制检定只能将效果抑制到你的下回合开始，而不是完全反制它，那么你可以每轮维持启动魔杖，来将效果再抑制1回合，至多到1分钟。你通过摇晃魔杖来维持启动，因此如果你在任何时候松开或丢下魔杖，效果则立即停止被抑制，恢复对目标的正常影响。

制作需求 视情况提供净化苦难，清神醒脑或身健体康的施法。

pl.name: Różdżka Oczyszczenia (Zaklęcie 8. Rangi)
pl.description:
This cypress onusa rod is decorated with a number of paper streamers that rustle when shaken to direct purification magic. Wands of purification contain either @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.SUKaxVZW2TlM8lu0]{Cleanse Affliction}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.EfFMLVbmkBWmzoLF]{Clear Mind}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Et8RSCLx8w7uOLvo]{Sound Body}, decided when the wand is created.

Activate @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.aBQ8ajvEBByv45yz]{Cast a Spell}

Frequency once per day, plus overcharge

Effect You cast cleanse affliction, clear mind, or sound body of the indicated level. If your counteract check would be sufficient only to suppress the effect until the beginning of your next turn, instead of to fully counteract it, then you can Sustain the Activation of the wand each round to suppress the effect for an additional round, to a maximum of 1 minute. You Sustain the Activation by shaking the wand, so if at any point you release or otherwise drop the wand, the effect immediately stops being suppressed and resumes on the target as normal.

Craft Requirements Supply a casting of cleanse affliction, clear mind, or sound body, as appropriate.

name: Wand of Reaching (1st-Rank)
description:
This long, slender wand is constructed of silver, polished to a mirror shine.

Activate Cast a Spell; This activation takes 2 if the spell normally takes 1 to cast, or 3 if the spell normally takes 2

Frequency once per day, plus overcharge

Effect You Cast the Spell. Its range increases by 30 feet. As normal for increasing ranges, if the spell normally has a range of touch, its range extends to 30 feet.

Craft Requirements Supply a casting of a spell of the appropriate rank. The spell must have a casting time of 1 or 2, and must have a range.

fr.name: Baguette d'atteinte (rang 1)
fr.description:
Cette longue et fine baguette est fabriquée en argent, poli pour obtenir l'aspect d'un miroir.

Activation Lancer un sort, cette activation prend 2 si le sort nécessite 1 pour être lancé ou 3 si le sort prend normalement 2

Fréquence Une fois par jour, plus surcharger

Effet Vous Lancez le sort. sa portée augmente de 9 mètres. Comme à l'ordinaire lorsqu'on augmente les portées, si le sort a normalement une portée de contact, sa portée passe à 9 mètres.

Conditions de Fabrication Fournir une incantation d'un sort du rang approprié. Le sort doit avoir un temps d'incantation de 1 ou 2 et doit avoir une portée.

zh.name: 1环级法术及远魔杖 Wand of Reaching (1st-Rank)
zh.description:
这个细长的魔杖由银所制成，抛光打磨得像镜子一样澈亮。

启动 施放法术；若法术通常需要1，启动该魔杖则需要2，若法术通常需要2，启动该魔杖则需要3

频率 每日一次，外加过载

效果 你施放法术。该法术的射程增加30尺。若通常情况下该法术的射程为接触，则将其射程增加至30尺。

制造需求 提供一次对应环级的该法术施法。该法术施法时间必须为1或2，且必须拥有射程。

name: Wand of Refracting Rays (4th-Rank)
description:
This wand is short and wide with a hexagonal, crystal shaft and a leather-wrapped handle. The wand refracts direct bright light into a rainbow.

Activate Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day, plus overcharge

Effect You cast 4th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Hb8GdAhP0zBCv3zU]{Chromatic Ray}. After you cast the spell, if you hit the target, the light refracts to another creature within 30 feet of the first target. Roll your spell attack roll and to determine the ray's color separately for each target. The ray continues to refract each time it hits. The refraction ceases if you miss any target, and you can end the refraction at any point. You can't target the same creature more than once, and you must have line of effect to all targets.

Craft Requirements Supply a casting of chromatic ray of the appropriate rank.

spell.name: Chromatic Ray
spell.description:
You send out a ray of colored light streaming toward your enemy, with a magical effect depending on the ray's color. Make a spell attack roll. If you hit, roll [[/r 1d4]]{1d4} to see which beam you cast. If the ray deals damage, that damage is doubled on a critical hit. Any additional traits that apply to a ray are listed in parentheses just after the name of the color.

  1. Red (fire) The ray deals @Damage[30[fire]] damage to the target.
  2. Orange (acid) The ray deals @Damage[40[acid]] damage to the target.
  3. Yellow (electricity) The ray deals @Damage[50[electricity]] damage to the target.
  4. Green (poison) The ray deals @Damage[25[poison]] damage to the target, and the target must succeed at a Fortitude save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} for 1 minute (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} on a critical failure).

Heightened (6th) The damage for @Damage[40[fire]]{Red}, @Damage[50[acid]]{Orange}, @Damage[60[electricity]]{Yellow}, and @Damage[35[poison]]{Green} each increase by 10. Roll [[/r 1d8]]{1d8} to determine the ray's color, using the results for 1-4 above and the results for 5-8 below.

  1. Blue The ray has the effect of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.znv4ECL7ZtuiagtA]{Petrify} spell. On a critical hit, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} as long as it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed} by the flesh to stone effect.
  2. Indigo (emotion, incapacitation, mental) The ray has the effect of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.LiGbewa9pO0yjbsY]{Confusion} spell. On a critical hit, it has the effect of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8kJbiBEjMWG4VUjs]{Warp Mind} instead.
  3. Violet The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed} for 1 minute. It must also succeed at a will save or be teleported 120 feet directly away from you (if there isn't room for it to appear there, it appears in the nearest open space); this is a teleportation effect.
  4. Intense Color The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} until the end of your next turn, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} if your attack roll was a critical hit. Roll again and add the effects of another color (rerolling results of 8).

fr.name: Baguette des rayons réfractés (Rang 4)
fr.description:
Cette baguette est courte et large avec une pointe en cristal hexagonal et une poignée entourée de cuir. La baguette réfracte la lumière vive directe dans un arc-en-ciel.

Activation Lancer un sort

Fréquence Une fois par jour, plus surcharger

Effet Vous lancez @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Hb8GdAhP0zBCv3zU]{Rayon chromatique} au rang 4. Après avoir lancé le sort, si vous touchez la cible, la lumière se réfracte vers une autre créature située à moins de 9 mètres de la première. Effectuez votre jet d'attaque du sort et déterminez la couleur du rayon séparément pour chaque cible. Le rayon continue de se réfracter à chaque fois qu'il touche. La réfraction cesse si vous manquez une cible et vous pouvez mettre fin à la réfraction à n'importe quel moment. Vous ne pouvez pas cibler la même créature plus d'une fois et vous devez avoir une ligne d'effet avec toutes les cibles.

Conditions de fabrication Fournir une incantation de Rayon chromatique au rang approprié.

zh.name: 4环级折射彩光魔杖 Wand of Refracting Rays (4th-Rank)
zh.description:
这根短粗魔杖的杖身乃是由六棱的水晶制成，其杖端则包裹成一层皮革。这根魔杖能将直射的强光折射成彩虹的模样。

启动 施放法术

频率 每日一次，外加过载

效果 你施放4环级的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Hb8GdAhP0zBCv3zU]法术。在你施法之后，若你命中目标，那么光束将会折射向初始目标30尺范围内的另一个生物。尝试一次法术攻击骰，并为每个目标分别掷骰以决定光束的色彩。光束射线会在每次命中之后继续折射。折射会在攻击失手后自动结束，你也可以在任何时候主动结束折射。你不能瞄准同一目标超过一次，你和所有法术目标之间都必须拥有效果线。

制造需求 提供一次对应环级的七彩射线施法

name: Wand of Rolling Flames (2nd-Rank)
description:
The luminous design of red-orange cracks on this black obsidian wand suggests cooling lava.

Activate Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day, plus overcharge

Effect You cast 2nd-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.2ZdHjnpEQJuqOYSG]{Floating Flame}. If you create the flame on the ground, the ground in the sphere's square and all adjacent squares are coated in rolling flames until the start of your next turn. These are difficult terrain and hazardous terrain. A creature that moves on the ground takes @Damage[1[fire]] damage for every square of rolling flames it moves into. If a creature in the flames doesn't move on its turn, it takes the damage for each of the squares it's in at the end of its turn. The first time you Sustain the Spell each round, the sphere creates rolling flames again in its new location (or the same location if you chose not to move it), provided it's on the ground.

Craft Requirements Supply a casting of floating flame of the appropriate rank.

spell.name: Floating Flame
spell.description:
You create a fire that burns without fuel and moves to your commands. The flame deals 3d6 fire damage to each creature in the square in which it appears, with a basic Reflex save. When you Sustain this spell, you can levitate the flame up to 10 feet. It then deals damage to each creature whose space it shared at any point during its flight. This uses the same damage and save, and you roll the damage once each time you Sustain. A given creature can take damage from floating flame only once per round.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

fr.name: Baguette des flammes flottantes (Rang 2)
fr.description:
Le dessin lumineux des fissures rouge-orangées de cette baguette en obsidienne noire évoque la lave en train de refroidir.

Activation Lancer un sort

Fréquence Une fois par jour, plus surcharger

Effet Vous lancez @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.2ZdHjnpEQJuqOYSG]{Flamme flottante} au rang 2. Si vous créez la flamme sur le sol, le sol de la case de la sphère et de toutes les cases adjacentes est recouvert de flammes ronflantes jusqu'au début de votre prochain tour. Il s'agit d'un terrain difficile et d'un terrain dangereux. Une créature qui se déplace sur le sol subit @Damage[1[fire]]]{1 dégât de feu} pour chaque case de flammes ronflantes dans laquelle elle se déplace. Si une créature dans les flammes ne se déplace pas à son tour, elle subit les dégâts pour chaque case dans laquelle elle se trouve à la fin de son tour. La première fois que vous Maintenez le sort à chaque round, la sphère crée à nouveau des flammes roulantes à son nouvel emplacement (ou au même emplacement si vous avez choisi de ne pas la déplacer).

Conditions de fabrication Fournir une incantation de Flamme flottante au rang approprié.

zh.name: 2环级滚火溅焰魔杖 Wand of Rolling Flames (2nd-Rank)
zh.description:
黑曜石魔杖的裂隙间透着橙红色的火光，整根魔杖就好似一束渐冷的岩浆。

启动 施放法术

频率 每日一次，外加过载

效果 你施放2环级的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.2ZdHjnpEQJuqOYSG]法术。直到你的下一个回合开始，法球所在方格和所有邻接的方格都被滚动的烈焰所席卷。滚焰方格属于困难地形以及有害地形。在地面上移动的生物会在每次进入一个滚焰方格时受到@Damage[1[fire]]伤害。滚焰中的生物若在其回合内没有移动，那么该生物将会在其回合结束时受到其所在方格所带来的伤害。当你每轮首次维持该法术时，法球将会在新的位置重新创造滚焰（若你选择不移动法球，那么它将会停留在其原本的位置）。

制造需求 提供一次对应环级的炽焰法球施法。

spell.name: Floating Flame
spell.description:
You create a fire that burns without fuel and moves to your commands. The flame deals 3d6 fire damage to each creature in the square in which it appears, with a basic Reflex save. When you Sustain this spell, you can levitate the flame up to 10 feet. It then deals damage to each creature whose space it shared at any point during its flight. This uses the same damage and save, and you roll the damage once each time you Sustain. A given creature can take damage from floating flame only once per round.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

fr.name: Baguette des flammes flottantes (Rang 3)
fr.description:
Le dessin lumineux des fissures rouge-orangées de cette baguette en obsidienne noire évoque la lave en train de refroidir.

Activation Lancer un sort

Fréquence Une fois par jour, plus surcharges

Effet Vous lancez @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.2ZdHjnpEQJuqOYSG]{Flamme flottante} au rang 3. Si vous créez la flamme sur le sol, le sol de la case de la sphère et de toutes les cases adjacentes est recouvert de flammes ronflantes jusqu'au début de votre prochain tour. Il s'agit d'un terrain difficile et d'un terrain dangereux. Une créature qui se déplace sur le sol subit @Damage[2[fire]]{2 dégâts de feu} pour chaque case de flammes ronflantes dans laquelle elle se déplace. Si une créature dans les flammes ne se déplace pas à son tour, elle subit les dégâts pour chaque case dans laquelle elle se trouve à la fin de son tour. La première fois que vous Maintenez le sort à chaque round, la sphère crée à nouveau des flammes roulantes à son nouvel emplacement (ou au même emplacement si vous avez choisi de ne pas la déplacer).

zh.name: 3环级滚火溅焰魔杖 Wand of Rolling Flames (3rd-Rank)

黑曜石魔杖的裂隙间透着橙红色的火光，整根魔杖就好似一束渐冷的岩浆。

When you Sustain this spell, you can levitate the flame up to 10 feet. It then deals damage to each creature whose space it shared at any point during its flight. This uses the same damage and save, and you roll the damage once each time you Sustain. A given creature can take damage from floating flame only once per round.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

fr.name: Baguette des flammes flottantes (Rang 8)
fr.description:
Le dessin lumineux des fissures rouge-orangées de cette baguette en obsidienne noire évoque la lave en train de refroidir.

Activation Lancer un sort

Fréquence Une fois par jour, plus surcharger

Effet Vous lancez @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.2ZdHjnpEQJuqOYSG]{Flamme flottante} au rang 8. Si vous créez la flamme sur le sol, le sol de la case de la sphère et de toutes les cases adjacentes est recouvert de flammes ronflantes jusqu'au début de votre prochain tour. Il s'agit d'un terrain difficile et d'un terrain dangereux. Une créature qui se déplace sur le sol subit @Damage[7[fire]]{7 dégâts de feu} pour chaque case de flammes ronflantes dans laquelle elle se déplace. Si une créature dans les flammes ne se déplace pas à son tour, elle subit les dégâts pour chaque case dans laquelle elle se trouve à la fin de son tour. La première fois que vous Maintenez le sort à chaque round, la sphère crée à nouveau des flammes roulantes à son nouvel emplacement (ou au même emplacement si vous avez choisi de ne pas la déplacer).

Conditions de fabrication Fournir une incantation de Flamme flottante au rang approprié.

zh.name: 8环级滚火溅焰魔杖 Wand of Rolling Flames (8th-Rank)
zh.description:
黑曜石魔杖的裂隙间透着橙红色的火光，整根魔杖就好似一束渐冷的岩浆。

启动 施放法术

频率 每日一次，外加过载

效果 你施放8环级的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.2ZdHjnpEQJuqOYSG]法术。直到你的下一个回合开始，法球所在方格和所有邻接的方格都被滚动的烈焰所席卷。滚焰方格属于困难地形以及有害地形。在地面上移动的生物会在每次进入一个滚焰方格时受到@Damage[7[fire]]伤害。滚焰中的生物若在其回合内没有移动，那么该生物将会在其回合结束时受到其所在方格所带来的伤害。当你每轮首次维持该法术时，法球将会在新的位置重新创造滚焰（若你选择不移动法球，那么它将会停留在其原本的位置）。

制造需求 提供一次对应环级的炽焰法球施法。

pl.name: Różdżka Wirujących Płomieni (8. Ranga)
pl.description:
The luminous design of red-orange cracks on this black obsidian wand suggests cooling lava.

Activate Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day, plus overcharge

Effect You cast 8th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.2ZdHjnpEQJuqOYSG]{Floating Flame}. If you create the flame on the ground, the ground in the sphere's square and all adjacent squares are coated in rolling flames until the start of your next turn. These are difficult terrain and hazardous terrain. A creature that moves on the ground takes @Damage[7[fire]] damage for every square of rolling flames it moves into. If a creature in the flames doesn't move on its turn, it takes the damage for each of the squares it's in at the end of its turn. The first time you Sustain the Spell each round, the sphere creates rolling flames again in its new location (or the same location if you chose not to move it), provided it's on the ground.

Craft Requirements Supply a casting of floating flame of the appropriate rank.

name: Wand of Shardstorm (1st-Rank Spell)
description:
This wand features a carved dragon's head at its top and a polished metal sphere set in its midsection.

Activate Cast a Spell

Frequency Once per day, plus overcharge

Effect You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage} at 1st rank.

After you cast the spell, an additional shard or shards are released from the wand at the start of each of your turns, as though you cast the 1-action version of force barrage. Choose targets each time. This lasts for 1 minute, until you're no longer wielding the wand, or until you try to activate the wand again.

Craft Requirements Supply a casting of force barrage of the appropriate rank.

spell.name: Force Barrage
spell.description:
You fire a shard of solidified magic toward a creature that you can see. It automatically hits and deals 1d4+1 force damage. For each additional action you use when Casting the Spell, increase the number of shards you shoot by one, to a maximum of three shards for 3 actions. You choose the target for each shard individually. If you shoot more than one shard at the same target, combine the damage before applying bonuses or penalties to damage, resistances, weaknesses, and so forth.

Heightened (+2) You fire one additional shard with each action you spend.

fr.name: Baguette de tempêtes d'éclats (Rang 1)
fr.description:
Cette baguette est ornée d'une tête de dragon à son extrémité et d'une sphère de métal poli au milieu.

Activation Lancer un sort

Fréquence Une fois par jour, plus surcharger

Effet Vous Lancez @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Salve de force} au rang 1. Après avoir lancé le sort, la baguette tire un ou plusieurs éclats supplémentaires au début de chacun de vos tours, comme si vous lanciez la version à 1 action de Salve de force. Choisissez les cibles à chaque fois. Ceci dure pendant 1 minute, jusqu'à ce que vous ne teniez plus la baguette en main ou que vous tentiez de l'activer à nouveau.

Conditions de fabrication Fournir une incantation de Salve de force du rang approprié.

zh.name: 1环级碎片风暴魔杖 Wand of Shardstorm (1st-Rank Spell)
zh.description:
这根魔杖顶端的外形被雕刻为巨龙的头部，在龙腹的位置安置着一颗抛光的金属球。

启动 施法

频率 每日一次，外加过载

效果 你施放对应环级的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]法术。

在你施放该法术后，一枚或多枚力场碎片会在你的每回合开始时从魔杖中释放而出，如同你施放了1动作版本的力场飞弹。你每次可以独立选择目标。此效果持续1分钟，或直到你不再持用魔杖，或直到你尝试再次启动魔杖。

制作需求 提供一次所列环级的力场飞弹施法。

name: Wand of Shattering Images
description:
Shattered pieces of a glass mirror, formed into a reflective mosaic, comprise the irregular shaft of this wand. The handle is black and polished smooth, the pommel capped with a tiny reflective orb.

Activate Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day, plus overcharge

Effect You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.j8vIoIEWElvpwkcI]{Mirror Image}. Each time an image is destroyed, the image shatters into sharp fragments of glass. If the creature that destroyed the image is adjacent to you, it takes @Damage[5[slashing]].

Craft Requirements Supply a casting of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.j8vIoIEWElvpwkcI]{Mirror Image}

fr.name: Baguettes d'images fracassantes
fr.description:
Le manche de cette baguette est irrégulier et se compose de morceaux de verre brisés qui forment une mosaïque réfléchissante. Le manche est noir et poli, et le pommeau est surmonté d'un minuscule orbe réfléchissant.

Activation Lancer un sort

Fréquence Une fois par jour, plus surcharger

Effet Vous lancez @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.j8vIoIEWElvpwkcI]{Image miroir}. Chaque fois qu'une image est détruite, l'image se fracasse en morceaux de verre coupants. Si la créature qui a détruit l'image vous est adjacente, elle subit @Damage[5[slashing]]{5 dégâts tranchants}.

Conditions de fabrication Fournir une incantation d'Image miroir

zh.name: 碎裂镜像魔杖 Wand of Shattering Images
zh.description:
这根魔杖的不规则杖身是由玻璃碎片所构成，一片片镜子组成了反光的马赛克图样。杖柄漆黑，抛光得很是光滑，在杖端处则嵌有一枚小小的反光球体。

启动 施法

频率 每日一次，外加过载

效果 你施@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.j8vIoIEWElvpwkcI]{镜影术 Mirror Image}法术。当镜影幻象被摧毁之际，它会碎裂成锋利的玻璃碎片。若摧毁幻象的生物邻接于你，他将会因此受到@Damage[5[slashing]]伤害。

制作需求 提供一次@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.j8vIoIEWElvpwkcI]{镜影术 Mirror Image}施法。

pl.name: Różdżka Druzgocących Obrazów
pl.description:
Shattered pieces of a glass mirror, formed into a reflective mosaic, comprise the irregular shaft of this wand. The handle is black and polished smooth, the pommel capped with a tiny reflective orb.

Activate Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day, plus overcharge

Effect You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.j8vIoIEWElvpwkcI]{Mirror Image}. Each time an image is destroyed, the image shatters into sharp fragments of glass. If the creature that destroyed the image is adjacent to you, it takes @Damage[5[slashing]].

Craft Requirements Supply a casting of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.j8vIoIEWElvpwkcI]{Mirror Image}

name: Wand of Shocking Haze
description:
Thin, shiny wires crisscross the surface of this smooth, black wand. The pommel is capped with a polished metal sphere, which sometimes emits small electric sparks.

Activate Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day, plus overcharge

Effect You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.3JG1t3T4mWn6vTke]{Blur}, and the wand creates faint orbs of electricity @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} in the haze around you. Each time a creature that's adjacent to you fails a flat check against the concealment from blur, they explode one of the orbs, causing them to take @Damage[5[electricity]] damage.

Craft Requirements Supply a casting of blur.

spell.name: Blur
spell.description: The target's form appears blurry. It becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}. As the nature of this effect still leaves the target's location obvious, the target can't use this concealment to Hide or Sneak.

fr.name: Baguette de brume électrisante
fr.description:
De fins fils métalliques brillants sillonnent la surface de cette baguette lisse et noire. Le pommeau est surmonté d'une sphère métallique polie qui émet parfois de petites étincelles électriques.

Activation Lancer un sort

Fréquence Une fois par jour, plus surcharger

Effet Vous Lancez @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.3JG1t3T4mWn6vTke]{Flou} et la baguette crée des orbes pâles d'électricité camouflées dans la brume qui vous entoure. Chaque fois qu'une créature qui vous est adjacente obtient un échec sur son test nu contre l'état Masqué de Flou, il explose l'un des orbes, ce qui le conduit à subir @Damage[5[electricity]]{5 dégâts d'électricité}.

Conditions de fabrication Fournir une incantation de Flou.

zh.name: 电击雾霭魔杖 Wand of Shocking Haze
zh.description:
细长的金属丝交错缠绕在这根光滑的黑色魔杖表面。魔杖柄部顶端镶嵌着一颗抛光金属球，有时会发出微弱的电火花。

启动 施放法术

频率 每日一次，外加过载

效果 你施放@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.3JG1t3T4mWn6vTke]，魔杖在你周围的雾气中创造出微小的电球。每次与你相邻的生物对来自朦胧术的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]的纯骰检定失败时，它会引爆其中一个电球，使其受到@Damage[5[electricity]]伤害。

制造需求 提供一次朦胧术施法

pl.name: Różdżka Porażającej Mgły
pl.description:
Thin, shiny wires crisscross the surface of this smooth, black wand. The pommel is capped with a polished metal sphere, which sometimes emits small electric sparks.

Frequency once per day, plus overcharge

name: Wand of Shrouded Step
description:
When you move this delicately carved poplar wand, it looks indistinct, leaving a trail of afterimages in its wake.

Activate Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day, plus overcharge

Effect You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aEM2cttJ2eYcLssW]{Fleet Step}. For the duration of the spell, you're also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} while you Stride.

Craft Requirements Supply a casting of fleet step.

spell.name: Fleet Step
spell.description:
You gain a +30-foot status bonus to your Speed.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.ThFug45WHkQQXcoF]{Spell Effect: Fleet Step}

fr.name: Baguette du Pas voilé
fr.description:
Lorsque vous déplacez cette baguette de peuplier délicatement sculptée, elle semble indistincte et laisse une traînée d'images rémanentes dans son sillage.

Activation Lancer un sort

Fréquence Une fois par jour, plus surcharger

Effet Vous lancez @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aEM2cttJ2eYcLssW]{Pas rapide}. Pendant la durée du sort vous êtes également @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Masqué} lorsque vous Marchez rapidement.

Conditions de fabrication Fournir une incantation de Pas rapide.

zh.name: 隐蔽移动魔杖 Wand of Shrouded Step
zh.description:
当你挥动这根精雕细琢的白杨木魔杖时，你似乎无法用肉眼精确捕捉它的踪迹，你只能看见其杖尖在空中留下的一串残影。

启动 施法

频率 每日一次，外加过载

效果 你施放@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aEM2cttJ2eYcLssW]法术。在法术的持续时间内，你在行走时处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]状态。

制作需求 提供一次快速移动施法。

pl.name: Różdżka Spowitego Kroku
pl.description:
When you move this delicately carved poplar wand, it looks indistinct, leaving a trail of afterimages in its wake.

Activate Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day, plus overcharge

Effect You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aEM2cttJ2eYcLssW]{Fleet Step}. For the duration of the spell, you're also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} while you Stride.

name: Wand of Slaughter (7th-Rank Spell)
description:
This polished black wand has a green gem at the tip, and anyone who looks into it sees a reflection of a grinning skull.

Activate Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day, plus overcharge

Effect You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Z9OrRXKgAPv6Hn5l]{Execute} at 7th-rank. If the spell slays a living target, the corpse releases grim energy in a @Template[emanation|distance:20], dealing @Damage[14[void]] damage.

Craft Requirements Supply a casting of execute at 7th-rank.

spell.name: Execute
spell.description:
You point at a creature and invoke the demise of all things. The target takes 70 void damage with a basic Fortitude save. If the target is undead or otherwise has void healing, the spell loses the death and void traits and gains the vitality trait, and the target takes 70 vitality damage with a basic Fortitude save.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 10.

fr.name: Baguette de massacre (rang 7)
fr.description:
Cette baguette noire et lustrée présente une gemme verte à son extrémité et quiconque regarde à l'intérieur voit le reflet d'un crâne grimaçant.

Activation Lancer un sort

Fréquence Une fois par jour, plus surcharger

Effet Vous Lancez @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Z9OrRXKgAPv6Hn5l]{Exécution} au rang 7. Si le sort tue une créature vivante, le cadavre libère une énergie sinistre dans une @Template[emanation|distance:20]{émanation de 6 mètres} en infligeant @Damage[14[void]]{14 dégâts de vide}.

Conditions de fabrication Fournir une incantation de Exécution de rang 7.

zh.name: 7环级杀生魔杖 Wand of Slaughter (7th-Rank Spell)
zh.description:
这根锃亮的黑色魔杖顶端有一颗绿色宝石，任何人凝视宝石的人，只会看到一个咧嘴大笑的头骨，而不是他们的脸。

启动 施放法术

频率 每日一次，外加过载

效果 你施放7环级@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Z9OrRXKgAPv6Hn5l]法术。若该法术击杀目标，尸体会放出@Template[emanation|distance:20]的恐怖能量，造成@Damage[14[void]]伤害。

制造需求 提供一次对应环级的处死一指施法。

spell.name: Fireball
spell.description:
A roaring blast of fire detonates at a spot you designate, dealing 6d6 fire damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

fr.name: Baguette de boules de feu incendiaires (Rang 3)
fr.description:
Cette baguette noircie et carbonisée émet une faible odeur de salpêtre.

Activation Lancer un sort

Fréquence Une fois par jour, plus surcharger

Effet Vous lancez @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.sxQZ6yqTn0czJxVd]{Boule de feu} au rang 3. Chaque créature qui rate son jet de sauvegarde subit @Damage[1d6[persistent,fire]]{1d6 dégâts de feu persistants}.

name: Wand Of Splintered Sorrows (Rank 2)
description:
This wooden wand is roughly cut, as if it had been crudely chopped from a tree and left forgotten. When held, the wand imparts feelings of deep sorrow.

Activate Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day, plus overcharge

Effect You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Bc6QqTmFV4q7G7L0]{Splinter Volley} of the indicated rank. Each splinter contains some of the despair felt by cruelly harvested trees, causing any creature damaged by this spell to become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for a number of rounds equal to the spell rank. On a critical success on the attack roll, the target also weeps, becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for the same duration.

Craft Requirements Supply a casting of splinter volley of the appropriate rank.

spell.name: Splinter Volley
spell.description:
You launch a volley of splinters at your foes. Make a spell attack roll against a single creature. On a hit, the splinters deal 4d6 piercing damage. The splinters deal double damage on a critical hit and @Damage[(floor(@item.level/2))[bleed]] damage. You can spend a third action while casting this spell to fire splinters at two different targets instead of one. These attacks each increase your multiple attack penalty, but you don't increase your multiple attack penalty until after you make both spell attack rolls for splinter volley.

Heightened (+2) Increase the damage dealt to each target by 4d6 and the persistent bleed damage by 1.

fr.name: Baguette des échardes de chagrin (rang 2)
fr.description:
Cette baguette de bois est grossièrement taillée, comme si elle avait été coupée sur un arbre et était restée oubliée. Quand on la tient en main, elle donne un sentiment de profonde tristesse.

Activation Lancer un sort

Fréquence Une fois par jour, plus surcharger

Effet Vous lancez le sort @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Bc6QqTmFV4q7G7L0]{Volée d'échardes} au rang 2. Chaque écharde contient un peu du désespoir ressenti par l'arbre si cruellement amputé, ce qui rend toute créature blessée par ce sort @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupéfiée 2} pendant un nombre de rounds égal au rang du sort. En cas de succès critique sur le jet d'attaque, la cible se met à sangloter, devenant également @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Ralentie 1} pendant la même durée.

Conditions de fabrication Fournir une incantation du sort Volée d'échardes au rang 2.

zh.name: 碎裂之哀魔杖（2环级）Wand Of Splintered Sorrows (Rank 2)
zh.description:
这根木制魔杖的截面十分粗糙，就好像刚刚被人粗鲁地从树上砍下来然后就被人遗忘了一般。在持握魔杖时，它会传来深深的忧伤。

启动 施法

频率 每日一次，外加过载

效果 你施放对应环级的 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Bc6QqTmFV4q7G7L0]{裂片激射 Splinter Volley} 。每个裂片都包含被残酷砍伐的树木所感受的绝望，这使得任何被该法术伤害的生物都会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 Stupefied 2} ，持续轮数等同于法术环级。当攻击检定获得大成功时，目标还会哭泣，在相同的持续时间内陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢 Slowed 1} 。

制作需求 提供一次对应环级的裂片激射法术施法。

Cette baguette de bois est grossièrement taillée, comme si elle avait été coupée sur un arbre et était restée oubliée. Quand on la tient en main, elle donne un sentiment de profonde tristesse.

Activation Lancer un sort

Fréquence Une fois par jour, plus surcharger

Effet Vous lancez le sort @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Bc6QqTmFV4q7G7L0]{Volée d'échardes} au rang 6. Chaque écharde contient un peu du désespoir ressenti par l'arbre si cruellement amputé, ce qui rend toute créature blessée par ce sort @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupéfiée 2} pendant un nombre de rounds égal au rang du sort. En cas de succès critique sur le jet d'attaque, la cible se met à sangloter, devenant également @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Ralentie 1} pendant la même durée.

Conditions de fabrication Fournir une incantation du sort Volée d'échardes au rang 6.

zh.name: 碎裂之哀魔杖（6环级）Wand Of Splintered Sorrows (Rank 6)
zh.description:
这根木制魔杖的截面十分粗糙，就好像刚刚被人粗鲁地从树上砍下来然后就被人遗忘了一般。在持握魔杖时，它会传来深深的忧伤。

启动 施法

频率 每日一次，外加过载

效果 你施放对应环级的 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Bc6QqTmFV4q7G7L0]{裂片激射 Splinter Volley} 。每个裂片都包含被残酷砍伐的树木所感受的绝望，这使得任何被该法术伤害的生物都会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 Stupefied 2} ，持续轮数等同于法术环级。当攻击检定获得大成功时，目标还会哭泣，在相同的持续时间内陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢 Slowed 1} 。

制作需求 提供一次对应环级的裂片激射法术施法。

pl.name: Różdżka Rozdartych Smutków (Ranga 6)
pl.description:
This wooden wand is roughly cut, as if it had been crudely chopped from a tree and left forgotten. When held, the wand imparts feelings of deep sorrow.

Activate Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day, plus overcharge

Effect You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Bc6QqTmFV4q7G7L0]{Splinter Volley} of the indicated rank. Each splinter contains some of the despair felt by cruelly harvested trees, causing any creature damaged by this spell to become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for a number of rounds equal to the spell rank. On a critical success on the attack roll, the target also weeps, becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for the same duration.

Craft Requirements Supply a casting of splinter volley of the appropriate rank.

spell.name: Splinter Volley
spell.description:
You launch a volley of splinters at your foes. Make a spell attack roll against a single creature. On a hit, the splinters deal 4d6 piercing damage. The splinters deal double damage on a critical hit and @Damage[(floor(@item.level/2))[bleed]] damage. You can spend a third action while casting this spell to fire splinters at two different targets instead of one. These attacks each increase your multiple attack penalty, but you don't increase your multiple attack penalty until after you make both spell attack rolls for splinter volley.

Heightened (+2) Increase the damage dealt to each target by 4d6 and the persistent bleed damage by 1.

name: Wand of Teeming Ghosts (2nd-Rank)
description:
This pale wooden wand is carved to resemble a thigh bone with metal caps at each end. Ghostly tendrils seem to swirl around it every so often.

Activate @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.aBQ8ajvEBByv45yz]{Cast a Spell}

Frequency once per day, plus overcharge

Effect You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8ViwItUgwT4lOvvb]{False Vitality} at 2nd-rank. During the duration of the spell, wisps that resemble spirits flit around you as long as you have any temporary Hit Points from false vitality, and you can use the following action.

Activation F (concentrate)

Trigger You successfully impart the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} condition to a creature

Requirements You have at least 1 temporary Hit Point from false vitality

Effect You end false vitality and increase the creature's frightened condition value to 2.

Craft Requirements Supply a casting of false vitality at 2nd-rank.

spell.name: False Vitality
spell.description:
You augment your flesh with the energies typically used to manipulate the undead. You gain 10 temporary Hit Points.

Heightened (+1) The temporary Hit Points increase by 3.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.PANUWN5xXC20WBg2]{Spell Effect: False Vitality}

fr.name: Baguette des fantômes grouillants (Rang 2)
fr.description:
Cette baguette en bois pâle est sculptée pour ressembler à un os de cuisse avec des capuchons métalliques à chaque extrémité. Des vrilles fantomatiques semblent tourbillonner autour d'elle de temps en temps.

Activation @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.aBQ8ajvEBByv45yz]{Lancer un sort}

Fréquence Une fois par jour, plus surcharger

Effet Vous lancez @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8ViwItUgwT4lOvvb]{Fausse vitalité} au rang 2. Pendant la durée du sort, des volutes pâles ressemblant à des esprits volent autour de vous tant que vous avez les Points de vie temporaires dus au sort Fausse vitalité et vous pouvez utiliser l'action suivante.

Activation F (concentration)

Déclencheur Vous imposez avec succès l'état @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Effrayé 1} à une créature

Conditions Vous avez au moins 1 Point de vie temporaire provenant de Simulacre

Effet Vous mettez fin au sort Fausse vitalité et augmentez la valeur de l'état Effrayé de la créature à 2.

Conditions de fabrication Fournir une incantation de Fausse vitalité au rang 2

zh.name: 2环级幽灵缠身魔杖 Wand of Teeming Ghosts (2nd-Rank)
zh.description:
这根浅色的木质魔杖被雕成了股骨的模样，魔杖的两端都镶有金属小帽。幽灵般的卷须似乎会时不时在其周围旋绕。

启动 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.aBQ8ajvEBByv45yz]

频率 每日一次，外加过载

效果 你施放2环级的@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8ViwItUgwT4lOvvb]法术。在法术的持续时间内，只要你仍然拥有着任何来自虚假生命的临时生命值，幽魂模样的微灵便环绕在你的周围，你将能够使用下述动作。

启动 F （专注）

触发 你成功使得一个生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 Frightened 1}状态

需求 你拥有至少1点来自虚假生命的临时生命值

效果 你结束虚假生命并将目标生物的惊惧状态值提高至2点。

制造需求 提供一次2环级虚假生命施法。

name: Wand of the Ash Puppet
description:
This wand is composed of ash that has been compressed, shaped, and sealed with a clear lacquer. When you trace the wand's tip along a solid surface, it leaves a black trail of charcoal. Writing with the wand in this way never damages or wears the wand down.

Activate Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day, plus overcharge

Effect You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.r7ihOgKv19eJQnik]{Disintegrate}. If the spell reduces a living creature to fine powder, you animate that creature's ashes into a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core-2.Actor.ekC1VHJtexh3AgVv]{Sulfur Zombie} with the same general appearance as the disintegrated creature. You control this sulfur zombie, which gains the minion and summoned traits. You can issue a verbal command to the sulfur zombie as a single action with the auditory and concentrate traits. The sulfur zombie crumbles into inanimate ash when reduced to 0 Hit Points or after 1 minute, whichever comes first.

Craft Requirements Supply a casting of disintegrate.

spell.name: Disintegrate
spell.description:
A black tracer bolt flies toward your target, and upon making contact intensifies into a powerful destructive beam. Make a spell attack against the target. If you hit an object or force construct (such as a wall of force), it's destroyed with no save unless it's an artifact or similarly powerful. A single casting can destroy no more than a 10-foot cube of matter. If you hit a creature, it takes 12d10 damage (no damage type) with a basic Fortitude save. If you critically hit, the target gets a result one degree of success worse than the outcome of its Fortitude save. A creature reduced to 0 HP is blasted to fine powder; its gear remains.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d10.
spell.target: 1 creature, unattended object, or force construct

fr.name: Baguette de la marionnette de cendres
fr.description:
Cette baguette est composée de cendres qui ont été compressées, formées et scellées avec une laque transparente. Lorsque vous tracez avec l'extrémité de la baguette sur une surface solide, elle laisse une trace noire de charbon de bois. Le fait d'écrire ainsi avec la baguette ne l'abîme pas et ne l'use pas.

Activation Lancer un sort

Fréquence Une fois par jour, plus surcharger

Effet Vous lancez @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.r7ihOgKv19eJQnik]{Désintégration}. zh.description:
这根魔杖是由经压缩、塑形以及密封的透明漆料所制成。当你用杖尖划过固体表面的时候，它将会在其上留下黑色炭迹。这根魔杖像这样被用来写画的时候，一点也不会被磨损或毁坏。

启动 施法

频率 每日一次，外加过载

效果 你施放@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.r7ihOgKv19eJQnik]法术。若一名活体生物被该法术解离成粉末，你能够将其捏塑成一头@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core-2.Actor.ekC1VHJtexh3AgVv]，该丧尸有着与被解离生物相同的相貌。你能够控制这头硫磺丧尸，它将会获得仆从以及召唤特征。你能够用一个单动作，对硫磺丧尸下达一则语言命令，该动作拥有听觉和专注特征。硫磺丧尸将会在生命值减少到0或在1分钟之后崩散成无生命的灰烬，以先到者为准。

pl.name: Różdżka Popielnej Marionetki
pl.description:
This wand is composed of ash that has been compressed, shaped, and sealed with a clear lacquer. When you trace the wand's tip along a solid surface, it leaves a black trail of charcoal. Writing with the wand in this way never damages or wears the wand down.

Activate Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day, plus overcharge

Effect You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.r7ihOgKv19eJQnik]{Disintegrate}. If the spell reduces a living creature to fine powder, you animate that creature's ashes into a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core-2.Actor.ekC1VHJtexh3AgVv]{Sulfur Zombie} with the same general appearance as the disintegrated creature. You control this sulfur zombie, which gains the minion and summoned traits. You can issue a verbal command to the sulfur zombie as a single action with the auditory and concentrate traits. The sulfur zombie crumbles into inanimate ash when reduced to 0 Hit Points or after 1 minute, whichever comes first.

Craft Requirements Supply a casting of disintegrate.

name: Wand of the Pampered Pet
description:
This extravagant wand is made of gold and capped with a large, sparkling gemstone. Its handle is wrapped in plush, padded fabric.

Activate Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day, plus overcharge

Effect You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.F1nlmqOIucch3Cmt]{Pet Cache} but the accommodations inside the extradimensional space are luxurious and spacious. The food is delicious gourmet cuisine tailored to the pet's palate, the habitat is the perfect temperature and environment for the pet, complete with comfortable bed or lounging area. A pair of phantom hands pamper the pet, patting, grooming, or playing with it at the creature's whim.

Craft Requirements Supply a casting of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.F1nlmqOIucch3Cmt]{Pet Cache}.

spell.name: Pet Cache
spell.description:
You open your cloak or create a gap with your hands, drawing the target into a pocket dimension just large enough for its basic comfort. No other creature can enter this extradimensional space, and the target can bring along objects only if they were designed to be worn by a creature of its kind. The space has enough air, food, and water to sustain the target for the duration.

You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AjLSHZSWQ90exdLo]{Dismiss} the spell. The spell also ends if you die or enter an extradimensional space. When the spell ends, the target reappears in the nearest unoccupied space (outside of any extradimensional space you may have entered).
spell.target: 1 willing creature that is your companion

La nourriture est une délicieuse cuisine gastronomique adaptée au palais de l'animal, l'habitat est à la température et constituent l'environnement parfaits pour l'animal avec une couche ou une aire de repos confortable. spell.name: Howling Blizzard
spell.description:
Freezing winds extend from your hands, pushing away from you with great force. If you Cast this Spell with 2 actions, it has an area of a 60-foot cone; if you Cast this Spell with 3 actions, it has a range of 500 feet and an area of a 30-foot burst. Each creature in the area takes 10d6 cold damage with a basic Reflex save. Snowdrifts and icy gales fill the area until the start of your next turn, making the area difficult terrain.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

name: Wand of the Spider (2nd-Rank Spell)
description:
The length of this wand is a pair of twisted giant spider legs.

Activate Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day, plus overcharge

Effect You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9s5tqqXNzcoKamWx]{Web} at 2nd-rank, but the strands of webbing are toxic. Any creature that fails its Athletics check or Reflex save to navigate the web takes @Damage[1d6[poison]] damage.

Craft Requirements Supply a casting of web at 2nd-rank.

spell.name: Web
spell.description:
You create a sticky web in the area that impedes creatures' movement. Squares filled with the web are difficult terrain. Each time a creature in the web begins to use a move action or enters the web during a move action it's using, it must attempt an @Check[athletics] check or Reflex save against your spell DC to avoid taking a circumstance penalty to its Speeds or becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}. A creature that gets out of the web ceases to take a circumstance penalty to its Speed from the web. Each square can be cleared of the web by a single attack or effect that deals at least 5 slashing damage or 1 fire damage. A square has AC 5, and it automatically fails its saving throws.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected, and it doesn't need to attempt further Athletics checks or saving throws against the web this turn. If it used an Athletics check, it clears the web from every square it leaves during its movement.

Success The creature is unaffected during its action. If it used an Athletics check, it clears the web from every square it leaves during its movement.

Failure The creature takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds until the start of its next turn.

Critical Failure The creature is immobilized until the start of its next turn, after which it takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds for 1 round. It can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} to remove its immobilized condition.

Heightened (4th) The spell's area increases to a @Template[burst|distance:20], and its range increases to 60 feet.

name: Wand of Tormented Slumber
description:
The carved talon of an unidentifiable beast comprises this wand. Blood-stained cloth wraps the thicker part of the talon, which acts as a handle.

Activate Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day, plus overcharge

Effect You cast 4th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.o4lRVTwSxnOOn5vl]{Sleep}, but the slumbering creatures have terrifying nightmares. A creature knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} by this spell takes @Damage[1d6[persistent,mental]]. This damage wakes the creature from unconsciousness only if it deals 4 or more damage on a single roll. If the creature awakens from its unconsciousness due to damage (whether it was the persistent mental damage or not), it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}. If it awakens from damage on its own turn, the creature doesn't reduce its frightened condition automatically on that turn.

Craft Requirements Supply a casting of 4th-rank sleep.

spell.name: Sleep
spell.description:
Each creature in the area becomes drowsy and might fall asleep. A creature that falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} from this spell doesn't fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} or release what it's holding. This spell doesn't prevent creatures from waking up due to a successful Perception check, limiting its utility in combat.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes a -1 status penalty to Perception checks for 1 round.

Failure The creature falls Unconscious. If it's still Unconscious after 1 minute, it wakes up automatically.

Critical Failure The creature falls Unconscious. If it's still Unconscious after 1 hour, it wakes up automatically.

Heightened (4th) The creatures fall Unconscious for 1 round on a failure or 1 minute on a critical failure. They fall Prone and release what they're holding, and they can't attempt Perception checks to wake up. When the duration ends, the creature is sleeping normally instead of automatically waking up.

fr.name: Baguette du sommeil tourmenté
fr.description:
Cette baguette est constituée de la griffe sculptée d'une bête non identifiable. Un tissu taché de sang enveloppe la partie la plus épaisse de la griffe, qui fait office de poignée.

Activation Lancer un sort

Fréquence Une fois par jour, plus surcharger

Effet Vous lancez @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.o4lRVTwSxnOOn5vl]{Sommeil} au rang 4, mais les créatures endormies font des cauchemars terrifiants. Une créature rendue @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Inconsciente} par ce sort subit @Damage[1d6[persistent,mental]]{1d6 dégâts mentaux persistants}. Ces dégâts ne sortent la créature de son inconscience que s'ils infligent 4 dégâts ou plus sur un unique jet. Si la créature sort de son inconscience à cause de dégâts (qu'il s'agisse des dégâts mentaux ou non), elle est @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Effrayée 1}. Si elle est réveillée par des dégâts lors de son propre tour, la créature ne peut réduire son état effrayé automatiquement lors de ce tour.

Conditions de fabrication Fournir une incantation de Sommeil au rang 4.

zh.name: 惊魂噩梦魔杖 Wand of Tormented Slumber
zh.description:
这根魔杖是由魔兽的利爪雕琢而成，其具体来源无法辨认。血迹斑斑的破布包裹着利爪较厚的部分，使得其能够充当杖柄供人持握。

启动 施法

频率 每日一次，外加过载

效果 你施放4环级@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.o4lRVTwSxnOOn5vl]，不过昏睡的生物将会遇见可怕的噩梦。一名因该法术@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]的生物将会受到@Damage[1d6[persistent,mental]]伤害。只有当该持续伤害在单次掷骰中造成了4点或更高的伤害时，才会将生物从失去意识中唤醒。若该生物因为受到伤害（无论是否是该效果所造成的持续心灵伤害）而苏醒，其将陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 Frightened 1}状态。若该生物是在他自己的回合因受到伤害而苏醒，那么其惊惧状态不会在那一回合自动衰减。

制作需求 提供一次4环级睡眠术施法。

spell.name: Blessed Boundary
spell.description:
Manifestations of divine force appear in the hundreds, swirling in a massive, protective sphere. These typically look like spiky fragments, but often take on an appearance themed to the deity of the caster. The sphere is hollow, with the manifestations forming a shell 2 inches deep on the outer edge. You can choose to make the burst smaller, in 5-foot increments, when you cast it. The shell provides cover and can intersect solid terrain without affecting it. The shell deals 7d8 force damage to each creature who intersects with the shell when the sphere's created, or who attempts to move through the shell. The creature also takes the damage at the end of its turn, but only if it didn't already take damage from the shell that turn. The effects are determined by a creature's Reflex save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage, is pushed up to 10 feet in the direction of your choice, and ends its movement.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, is pushed up to 20 feet in the direction of your choice, and ends its movement.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d8.

Une créature ne peut être exposée au poison plus d'une fois par tour.

Conditions de fabrication Fournir une incantation de Frontière bénie au rang approprié.

spell.name: Blessed Boundary
spell.description:
Manifestations of divine force appear in the hundreds, swirling in a massive, protective sphere. These typically look like spiky fragments, but often take on an appearance themed to the deity of the caster. The sphere is hollow, with the manifestations forming a shell 2 inches deep on the outer edge. You can choose to make the burst smaller, in 5-foot increments, when you cast it. The shell provides cover and can intersect solid terrain without affecting it. The shell deals 7d8 force damage to each creature who intersects with the shell when the sphere's created, or who attempts to move through the shell. The creature also takes the damage at the end of its turn, but only if it didn't already take damage from the shell that turn. The effects are determined by a creature's Reflex save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage, is pushed up to 10 feet in the direction of your choice, and ends its movement.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, is pushed up to 20 feet in the direction of your choice, and ends its movement.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d8.

spell.name: Mind Probe
spell.description:
You cast your thoughts through a creature's mind, sifting for information. You access the target's memories and knowledge unless it fends you off with a Will save.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure Each round of the spell's duration, you can Sustain the spell to ask a different question and attempt to uncover the answer. For each question, the target can attempt a Deception check against your spell DC; if the target succeeds, you don't learn the answer, and on a critical success, the target gives you a false answer that you believe is truthful Once you've asked the target a given question, asking it again, even with a separate casting of mind probe, produces the same result.

Critical Failure As failure, and the target takes a –4 circumstance penalty to Deception checks against your questions.

Cela signifie que vous obtenez la réponse si le test de Duperie de la cible devrait avoir été un succès et vous n'apprenez rien au lieu de croire un mensonge si le test devrait avoir été un succès critique.

spell.name: Uncontrollable Dance
spell.description:
The target is overcome with an all-consuming urge to dance. For the duration of the spell, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} and can't use reactions. name: Wandering Pipe
description:
This long-stemmed pipe always emits a thin plume of smoke, even when not lit or in active use. The exact material the pipe is made of varies in every accounting; sometimes made of polished oak, other times ebony, sometimes stone, and in one Erutaki legend the pipe is made of pure ice that somehow holds a flame. Though the wandering pipe is not intelligent, it is rumored to possess a certain capriciousness, leaving the possession of mortals whose lives are not exciting enough but inevitably finding its way back to its one true owner.

When held in one hand, the pipe grants its holder a +2 circumstance bonus to Deception checks but imposes a -1 circumstance penalty to Stealth checks made to Hide or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak}, as its telltale plume of smoke gives away the bearer's position.

Activate—Smoky Protections 2 (concentrate, manipulate, primal)

Frequency once per hour; Cost 1 Mythic Point

Effect For the next 10 minutes, smoke gathers around you buoying your steps and protecting you. For the duration of this effect, you gain a fly Speed equal to your land Speed and automatically hover in place, and you have concealment from ranged attacks.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.z480XhE3nft1TQDj]{Effect: Smoky Protections}

Destruction The wandering pipe can be broken as easily as any other wooden pipe, but it always reforms afterward in the hands of the Immortal Trickster or one of his bonded mortals. It can only be broken by the hands of one of the Trickster's bonded mortals who is an honest person acting with good intent; it is said that if this occurs, the Trickster would also be significantly weakened as a result.

fr.name: Pipe vagabonde
fr.description:
Cette pipe à long tuyau émet toujours un mince panache de fumée, même lorsqu'elle n'est pas allumée ou en cours d'utilisation. Le matériau exact dont est faite la pipe varie selon les récits : tantôt en chêne poli, tantôt en ébène, tantôt en pierre et dans une légende Érutakie, la pipe est faite de glace pure qui, d'une manière ou d'une autre, tient une flamme. Bien que la Pipe vagabonde ne soit pas intelligente, on dit qu'elle est quelque peu capricieuse, quittant la possession des mortels dont les vies ne sont pas assez excitantes mais trouvant inévitablement son chemin de retour vers son véritable propriétaire.

Lorsqu'elle est tenue en main, la pipe accorde à celui qui la tient un bonus de circonstances de +2 aux tests de Duperie mais impose une pénalité de circonstances de -1 aux tests de Discrétion faits pour Se cacher ou @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Être furtif}, car son panache de fumée révélateur indique la position du porteur.

Activation - Protections fumeuses 2 (concentration, manipulation, primordial)

Fréquence Une fois par heure

Coût 1 Point mythique

Effet Pendant les 10 prochaines minutes, la fumée s'accumule autour de vous, vous aidant à avancer et vous protégeant. Pendant la durée de cet effet, vous obtenez une vitesse de vol égale à votre vitesse terrestre et planez automatiquement sur place et vous êtes Masqué contre les attaques à distance.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.z480XhE3nft1TQDj]{Effet : Protections fumeuses}

Destruction La pipe itinérante peut être Brisée aussi facilement que toute autre pipe en bois, mais elle se reforme toujours par la suite entre les mains du Mystificateur immortel ou de l'un des mortels qui lui sont liés. Elle ne peut être Brisée que par les mains d'un des mortels liés au Mystificateur immortel qui soit une personne honnête agissant avec une bonne intention. Il est dit que si cela se produit, le Mystificateur devrait être significativement affaibli par le résultat.

zh.name: 漫游烟斗 Wandering Pipe
zh.description:
这根长柄烟斗即使未被点燃或使用，依旧不断冒出细细的烟雾。关于它的材质在记载中各不相同：有时是抛光橡木，有时是乌木、石材，甚至有一个艾鲁塔基传说中说它是由纯冰制成却仍能燃烧火焰。虽然漫游烟斗没有智能，但据说它有一种任性的个性——会离开那些生活过于平淡的凡人，但最终总会回到唯一真正的主人手中。

当你单手持握烟斗时，你在进行欺骗检定时获得+2环境加值，但在进行躲藏或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]的隐秘检定时承受–1环境减值，因为那缕标志性的烟雾会暴露你的所在。

启动—烟雾防护（Smoky Protections） 2 （专注，操作，原能）

频率 每小时一次；消耗 1神话点

效果 烟雾在你周围聚集，托举你的步伐并给予你守护。在接下来的10分钟内，你获得与陆地速度相等的飞行速度并自动悬浮，同时你对远程攻击具有隐蔽。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.z480XhE3nft1TQDj]

摧毁 漫游烟斗可以像任何普通木质烟斗一样轻松被打破，但总会在不朽诡术师或其任一连结凡人手中重新形成。只有诡术师的一位连结凡人，且此人必须是诚实之人并出于善意，方可真正摧毁它。传言称，若发生此事，不朽诡术师的力量也将随之大幅削弱。

pl.name: Fajka Wędrówki
pl.description:
This long-stemmed pipe always emits a thin plume of smoke, even when not lit or in active use. The exact material the pipe is made of varies in every accounting; sometimes made of polished oak, other times ebony, sometimes stone, and in one Erutaki legend the pipe is made of pure ice that somehow holds a flame. Though the wandering pipe is not intelligent, it is rumored to possess a certain capriciousness, leaving the possession of mortals whose lives are not exciting enough but inevitably finding its way back to its one true owner.

When held in one hand, the pipe grants its holder a +2 circumstance bonus to Deception checks but imposes a -1 circumstance penalty to Stealth checks made to Hide or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak}, as its telltale plume of smoke gives away the bearer's position.

Activate—Smoky Protections 2 (concentrate, manipulate, primal)

Frequency once per hour; Cost 1 Mythic Point

Effect For the next 10 minutes, smoke gathers around you buoying your steps and protecting you. For the duration of this effect, you gain a fly Speed equal to your land Speed and automatically hover in place, and you have concealment from ranged attacks.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.z480XhE3nft1TQDj]{Effect: Smoky Protections}

Destruction The wandering pipe can be broken as easily as any other wooden pipe, but it always reforms afterward in the hands of the Immortal Trickster or one of his bonded mortals. It can only be broken by the hands of one of the Trickster's bonded mortals who is an honest person acting with good intent; it is said that if this occurs, the Trickster would also be significantly weakened as a result.

name: War Blood Mutagen (Greater)
description:
Upon drinking this mutagen, you can feel your blood surge through your body and hear a low-pitched humming in your ears. These sensations subside as the flesh and muscles of your arm loosen and stretch, the fibers of your very being reaching out to combine with the base of one melee weapon you're holding.

Benefit Choose one melee weapon you're holding in one or both hands. You gain a +3 item bonus to your attack rolls with this weapon and to Will saves against fear effects for 1 hour. Any attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} or otherwise remove the weapon from your hands must exceed DC 40 or the attempt fails.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.8RNPIAuV7ixaXeq5]{Effect: War Blood Mutagen (Greater)}

Drawback You can't voluntarily remove the weapon unless you succeed at a @Check[athletics|dc:40], which ends the war blood mutagen's effects; this check takes a single action. If you perform an action with the concentrate trait, you must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:5] or the action is lost.
publication: Pathfinder #178: Punks in a Powder Keg

fr.name: Mutagène de sang guerrier supérieur
fr.description:
En buvant ce mutagène, vous pouvez sentir votre sang circuler dans votre corps et entendre un bourdonnement sourd dans vos oreilles. Ces sensations s'estompent alors que la chair et les muscles de votre bras se relâchent et s'étirent, les fibres de votre être s'étendant pour se combiner avec la base de l'arme au corps-à-corps que vous tenez.

Avantage Choisissez une arme au corps-à-corps que vous tenez dans une ou deux mains. Vous obtenez un bonus d'objet de +3 à vos jets d'attaque avec cette arme et aux jets de Volonté contre les effets de terreur pendant 1 heure. Toute tentative pour vous @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Désarmer} ou vous retirer d'une autre manière l'arme de vos mains doit dépasser un DD 40 ou échouer.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.8RNPIAuV7ixaXeq5]{Effet : Mutagène de sang guerrier supérieur}

Inconvénient Vous ne pouvez pas retirer volontairement l'arme, sauf si vous réussissez un test d'@Check[athletics|dc:40], ce qui met un terme aux effets d'un mutagène de sang guerrier. Ce test nécessite une action unique. Si vous accomplissez une action avec le trait concentration, vous devez réussir un @Check[flat|dc:5] ou l'action est perdue.

zh.name: 高等战争之血突变药剂 War Blood Mutagen (Greater)
zh.description:
当你喝下这种突变药剂时，你会感到血液在你的身体里涌动，耳朵里有一种低沉的嗡嗡声。当你手臂的肌肉放松和伸展时，这些感觉就会消退。你的身体会伸出纤维，与你持握的一件近战武器的把手结合。

好处 选择一把你正以单手或双手持握的近战武器。你使用这件武器的攻击骰和对抗恐惧效果的意志豁免中获得+3物品加值，持续时间1小时。任何从你手中 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{卸武 Disarm}或以其他方式移除武器的尝试都必须克服DC 40，否则尝试失败。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.8RNPIAuV7ixaXeq5]{效果：高等战争之血突变药剂}

缺陷 你无法自愿移除武器，除非你成功通过@Check[athletics|dc:40]检定，这会结束战争之血突变药剂的效果；该尝试需要一个单动作。如果你执行一个带有专注特征的动作，你必须通过@Check[flat|dc:5]检定，否则动作丢失。
